mapper.select: select v.verify_id as verifyId, a.apply_id as applyId, a.apply_no as applyNo, a.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, case v.verify_status when '0' then '验证码待提交，请在有效期内完成税务验证' else '验证码已提交，等待税务系统核验结果' end as note from t_tax_verify v inner join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = v.biz_id and a.del_flag = '0' left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id where v.biz_type = '1' and v.verify_status in ('0', '1') and a.member_id = #{memberId} order by v.create_time desc, v.verify_id desc
